annotations.title: Calculate IRRF, CSRF (PIS/COFINS/CSLL), INSS and ISS withheld on a B2B service invoice

description: Calculates the taxes a Brazilian company must withhold when paying a B2B service invoice (NFS-e): IRRF at 1.5% or 1%, CSRF at 4.65% split into PIS, COFINS and CSLL, INSS at 11% on labour-supply services, and ISS when the buyer retains it, applying the BRL 10.00 minimum waivers and exempting Simples Nacional providers from the federal withholdings; it returns the net amount to transfer. Use it in accounts payable before paying a supplier, or on the provider side to predict what will reach the bank. Do not use it for goods (NF-e), for payments to individuals, or to decide the municipality's ISS rate, which you must pass in. Read 'nfseRetentions'. Costs 0.008 USDC per call, paid with x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or with a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header instead of an exception, and every failure is a JSON body with 'error', so an agent loop never breaks on a thrown error. Deterministic arithmetic at the edge: nothing is stored or filed, no government system is contacted, and the same input always gives the same numbers. Results are estimates for planning and reconciliation, not a substitute for an accountant's sign-off.

aiSummary.description: When true (the default) the response carries 'aiExecutiveBrief', one Portuguese sentence of at most 35 words with the key amounts, written by an edge model with a deterministic fallback. Set false to skip it when you only need the numbers.

invoiceAmount.description: Gross amount of the service invoice, in BRL, for example 15000.

isSimplesNacional.description: True when the provider is a Simples Nacional company, which removes IRRF, CSRF and INSS withholding.

issRatePct.description: Municipal ISS rate in percent, between 2 and 5 by law; values above 5 are capped at 5. Used only when retainIss is true.

retainIss.description: True when the buyer withholds ISS at source, as many municipalities require for out-of-town providers.

serviceType.description: 'consultoria_ti_contabil' (default) for professional, IT and accounting services: IRRF 1.5% + CSRF 4.65%. 'limpeza_vigilancia' for cleaning, security and labour supply: IRRF 1% + CSRF 4.65% + INSS 11%. 'geral' for other services: IRRF 1.5% only.

name: calculate_nfse_withholdings

outputSchema.description: Single JSON document. All three tools of this server share one paid call and return the same envelope; each fills the block named in its description.

aiExecutiveBrief.description: One Portuguese sentence with the key amounts, present unless aiSummary is false.

error.description: Portuguese failure reason, present only on a rejected call, such as an invalid JSON body (HTTP 400).

nfseRetentions.description: Federal and municipal withholdings on a B2B service invoice. Amounts in BRL rounded to cents.

csrfBreakdown.description: CSRF split for the payment slips.

csrfPccWithheld.description: PIS + COFINS + CSLL withheld at 4.65%, set to 0 when it would be BRL 10.00 or less.

inssWithheld.description: INSS withheld at 11% on labour-supply services such as cleaning and security, otherwise 0.

irrfWithheld.description: IRRF withheld, 1.5% or 1%, set to 0 when it would be BRL 10.00 or less (legal waiver).

issWithheld.description: ISS withheld by the buyer when retainIss is true, otherwise 0.

netPayable.description: Amount the buyer actually transfers to the provider.

providerSimplesNacional.description: Whether the provider was treated as a Simples Nacional company, which removes IRRF, CSRF and INSS withholding.

processingTimeMs.description: Edge processing time in milliseconds, also in the X-Processing-Time-Ms header.

suggestedNextSteps.description: Chaining hints for autonomous agents: sibling paid APIs commonly called next, such as a CNPJ check of the Simples Nacional status. Purely advisory.

endpoint.description: Absolute HTTPS endpoint of the follow-up API.

priceUsdc.description: Price of the follow-up call in USDC.

tool.description: Tool name of the suggested follow-up API.

when.description: Condition under which the follow-up is worth making.
